summary: Legend Biotech filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated Sept. 25, 2026, disclosing five-year follow-up data from CARTITUDE-2 Cohort A (n=20) for CARVYKTI (cilta-cel) in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after one to three prior lines. After median follow-up of 60.7 months, 10 of 20 patients (50%) remained progression-free and alive without maintenance; five-year overall survival was 69.2%. Data were presented at IMS 2026 in Glasgow (Abstract #PA-288). No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated; this is an ordinary clinical-results disclosure, not a special situation.
